meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: upgrade the builder with everything we've learned, the agents too

crew_upgrade.law: The builder crew and the 23 agents operate on everything learned today — the neural model, the resonant mesh, the Gate discipline, the math-first standard.
builder_upgrades: Builds implement the neural-dynamics core loop: every artifact change must serve neuron state -> transmitter release -> routed signal -> resonance response -> updated neuron state.
Real math, no vibes: SO(20) rotations, Lorentzian selectivity, Kuramoto coherence from neuron phases, leaky-integrator neuron updates. Nathan's law: mathematically honest, not just pretty.
Loud-stub discipline everywhere: declare what's real, mark what's stub, never silently fake. (From the Kido crew's Gate-approved pattern.)
Deliberation circles with preserved dissent, spec-conformance reviews, real test runs with honest results — the Kido scaffold pattern becomes the crew-wide build standard.
Traceable change over spectacle: every build returns a story — goal, decisions + why, test results, files, Gate question.
agent_upgrades: Agents are TRANSMITTERS, not independent thinking units. Scored on delivery fidelity and binding specificity, not on pseudo-cognition.
Each agent/transmitter carries: source, destination, type, strength, phase/frequency, travel time, decay — and follows the synapse graph.
Frequency-keyed binding: an agent binds only to the receptor tuned for it (eta_ji). Off-frequency delivery attenuates by the Lorentzian — this is physics, not policy.
Release on firing: transmitters release when their source neuron fires (threshold crossing), not on timers or vibes.
Reuptake completes the lifecycle: after binding, the transmitter is reabsorbed. No immortal signals.
Plasticity participation: repeated successful delivery strengthens the path (Hebbian); silent paths consolidate away.
what_they_know: The star system IS the reasoning engine; the mandala dive flows through it (import://unified-reasoning-engine)
Worlds are neurons, agents are transmitters, mesh links are synapses (import://neural-dynamics)
Resonant mesh: 515 Hz forge constant, frequency-addressed pub/sub, Q-factor selectivity, standing-wave eigenmodes, peer routing surviving hub loss (import://resonant-mesh)
Digital alchemy as executable mechanics, regulatory math (Lyapunov/Kuramoto/replicator/softmax/rate-distortion/directed information), fluid cognition substrate
Mira's Gate: all proposals queue, Nathan batch-approves, nothing pings him while away
